transcript.company: Example Dental Partners (example-dental.example), an invented three-office dental group

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Thanks for making the time, Marcus. I've got us down for thirty minutes. I'd like to hear how bookings work across your sites today, see if the problems are ones we solve, and if they are, agree on a next step. Does that work?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Sure, that works.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Great. So, how do patients book with you today?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Mostly by phone. We use the scheduler that came with our practice software, and the front desk at each office keeps its own book.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: And how many offices, and how many people take bookings?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Three offices now, the third opened in June. Eleven hygienists and dentists who get booked, plus four front desk staff.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Let me tell you a bit about us, because I think it fits. We do online booking, automatic text and email reminders, deposits at booking and two-way calendar sync, and on the Business plan everything sits in one calendar across all your locations, so the front desk at one office can see and fill gaps at the others. Our customers usually turn on reminders in the first week and deposits in the second, and we move the existing appointments over for you. Most clinics your size are live in about two weeks, and the reminders alone tend to change the no-show picture quickly. We also integrate with the big calendar tools, so your team doesn't have to double-enter anything.

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Okay. No-shows are a thing for us, for sure.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: How many would you say you get in a month?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Honestly, quite a lot. More since the new office opened.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Has that changed how the front desk spends its day?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: They're on the phone half the morning confirming tomorrow's patients, and they still get gaps.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Is the phone time or the gaps the bigger problem for you?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: The gaps. An empty hygiene chair is lost money.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Who else would be involved in choosing a new system?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: I'd run it by the partners. Dr. Okafor, the managing partner, signs anything like this.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Would she want to see a demo?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Probably, if I tell her it's worth it.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: And timing, is there a contract with the current scheduler?

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: It renews in March. We'd want to decide before February.

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: What would this cost for three offices?

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: The Business plan covers up to twenty bookable staff, so you'd fit in one plan. I'll put the details in an email.

lines.speaker: Marcus (operations manager, Example Dental Partners)
lines.text: Okay, send me something and we'll find a time.

lines.speaker: Dana (account executive, Example Booking Software)
lines.text: Will do. Thanks, Marcus.
